calculation_definitions.censoring: no median, throughput, or speedup when any planned repeat timed out or was skipped
calculation_definitions.controller_invocation_wall_cost: median controller_wall_seconds over five completed warmed-primary repeats; includes process startup, preparation, warm-up, communication, engine replay, and cleanup; not pure parsing-plus-engine time
calculation_definitions.latency_percentiles: ordinary median; nearest-rank P95/P99 over retained per-event observations
calculation_definitions.latency_windows: first 10% and last 10% by event-stream position
calculation_definitions.median: Python statistics.median over exactly five completed raw repeats
calculation_definitions.memory: tracemalloc Python allocations; not process RSS
calculation_definitions.parsing: separate warmed-cache filesystem/gzip read-decompression and preloaded JSONL decoding; five repeats per core workload; no engine import or replay
calculation_definitions.speedup: baseline_median_seconds / optimized_median_seconds; only when both have five completed repeats

correctness_outcomes.evidence: 51 tests; zero failures, errors, or skips
Both engines matched exact fills, final book, and proceeds
15 streams / 15,000 events compared after every event

limitations: Timeout-censored configurations do not have ordinary five-repeat medians, throughput, or speedups.
Per-event clocks perturb latency; instrumented latency is separate from primary timing.
tracemalloc measures traced Python allocations, not total process RSS or native memory.
Four-level price mapping also changes FIFO queue lengths and matching relationships.
Version A diagnostic scan counts are analytical estimates; Version B wrapper/heap counters are directly observed where labelled.
OneDrive, operating-system scheduling, and thermal state were not fully controlled.
